positive_evidence: Nexto mean reward per decision improved monotonically from update 500 through 600.
Nexto goalward-touch fraction improved from 0.833713 to 0.846211.
Nexto touches per minute finished above update 500 after the update-550 dip.
Frozen-V5 touches per minute rose from 15.539063 to 16.652344.
Frozen-V5 weighted state potential rose from 0.104758 to 0.108710.
No-touch resets remained zero for both opponents at all three markers.
mixed_or_negative_evidence: Frozen-V5 mean reward per decision and goalward-touch fraction declined.
Nexto weighted state potential declined despite reward, touch, and goalward-touch improvement.
The short fixed windows recorded no goals or concessions and therefore do not establish scoring progress.
review.decision_basis: The frozen prospective rule requires a positive gameplay or objective-aligned trend without material scoring, touch-acquisition, or no-touch collapse. The series is mixed but satisfies that condition, led by monotonically improving Nexto reward and goalward-touch quality, recovered touches against Nexto, stronger frozen-V5 touch acquisition and state potential, and zero no-touch resets.
